title: Group Room Blocks Contracting Clause: Proposals, Option Period and Signature
content:
**Clause 1 — Requests contracted as a block.** Group sales proposes a Group Room Blocks contract only when the request has at least the block type's fewest and at most its most rooms on its peak night, at least the block type's fewest total room nights, and an arrival no more than the block type's booking window of calendar days away. Smaller requests are booked as transient reservations, and larger ones go to the brand's national sales office.

**Clause 2 — Tentative hold.** The proposal holds the proposed room nights out of inventory on a tentative basis, recorded once per block as the block's allocation entry on the block ledger.

**Clause 3 — Cut-off date.** The cut-off date is the block type's cut-off period of calendar days before the arrival date.

**Clause 4 — Signature.** The organiser signs the contract themselves. Signing commits the organiser to the contracted room nights, the attrition clause and the cancellation scale, so guest services never signs on the organiser's behalf. The organiser's signature is the act by which a tentative block becomes definite, as qualified by Clause 6 for block types that require the signing deposit.

**Clause 5 — Option period.** The contract can be signed only within the block type's option period of calendar days after the proposal was issued. Days are counted as whole calendar days from the proposal date, which is day zero; a signature on the last day of the option period is accepted. The proposal date is the one shown on the block record.

**Clause 6 — Signing deposit.** Where the block type requires the signing deposit to be received for the contract to be signed, the contract becomes definite only once the signing deposit has been received, as shown by a signing deposit receipt on the block ledger.

**Clause 7 — Lapse.** A tentative block whose option period ends without a signature lapses, its status becoming cancelled, and its rooms are released.

### Option period on the calendar (hypothetical 14-day option period)

| Day counted from the proposal date | Signature |
|---|---|
| Day 0 (the proposal date) | within the option period |
| Day 13 | within the option period |
| Day 14 (the last day) | accepted |
| Day 15 | outside the option period |

### Signature and deposit combined

| Block type requires the signing deposit for signature | Signing deposit receipt on the ledger | Signed within the option period | Contract definite |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | Yes | No |
| No | not required | Yes | Yes |
